title: drymocallis glandulosa subsp. globosa
intro: Drymocallis glandulosa subsp. globosa, commonly known as globed dryad's saddle, is a plant species belonging to the rose family (Rosoideae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its use in treating various health conditions, such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits in reducing inflammation and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of globed dryad's saddle include anti-inflammatory, expectorant, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its traditional use in herbal medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal activities.
